Use pimpleFoam for a transient, incompressible, laminar 2D simulation of flow past a cylinder.
The mesh is one cell thick.
Define the frontAndBack patches in constant/polyMesh/boundary with type empty.
Set the boundary condition for frontAndBack in 0/U to type empty.
Set the boundary conditions for inlet, outlet, and cylinderWall appropriately for a flow-past-cylinder case.
Do not use symmetryPlane unless the complete requirement is explicitly changed to use symmetryPlane for both the boundary file and 0/U.
